title: ChatGPT shared conversation — "Analysis recovery patch"
role: Layer-3 relay: the long-form Grok outputs as pasted back by the operator, plus the ChatGPT-authored prompts that elicited them, plus the drafting turns that produced the v0.1 package
capture_method: HTTP GET of the public share URL, saved verbatim; transcript derived locally by decode_share.py from the page's own turbo-stream payload
integrity_note: The .html is a dynamically served page carrying a per-response CSP nonce; a re-fetch will NOT reproduce this file's sha256. The stable, checkable artifact is the decoded transcript, which decode_share.py re-derives from these exact bytes. The share URL is owner-revocable and may cease to resolve.
limitations: The Grok outputs are operator copy-paste relays, not a native Grok export: no Grok-side timestamps, no session id, no displayed model/mode attestation, no rate-limit message.
Timestamps are ChatGPT-side receipt times and bound the true Grok times from above only.
The operator's own prompts to Grok are not separately preserved; what is preserved is the prompt text ChatGPT composed for pasting.
Whether every composed prompt was pasted verbatim is operator-attested and not independently verifiable.
